User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the NeupLedger application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

definition.description: Stores financial accounts for each user. The 'userId' path segment enforces ownership, ensuring only the authenticated user can access their accounts. The 'accountId' allows direct access to specific account documents. No denormalization is required as authorization is path-based.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the account.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage user accounts in the NeupLedger application. It leverages path-based ownership for managing user-specific accounts, which provides a clear and secure method for access control. This design emphasizes authorization independence by avoiding `get()` calls in security rules, which supports atomic operations. Each account is directly associated with a user via the path `/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}`, ensuring that access control can be implemented efficiently using `request.auth.uid`. This structure facilitates secure `list` operations because access control is based solely on the user ID in the path. The `accountId` is included in the path to enable direct access to specific account documents. Denormalization isn't explicitly required in this simple user-account relationship, as authorization is already path-based.
